source: ZXNAME0000XZ’s durable promise is conditional computation: increase the parameter capacity available to the model without forcing every token through every expert parameter. Its durable difficulty is that conditional computation produces dynamic, imbalanced, distributed work that dense hardware does not execute automatically well.
zh: ZXNAME0000XZ 的持久承诺是条件计算：增加模型可用的参数容量，而不强制每个令牌通过每个专家参数。其持久的困难在于条件计算会产生动态的、不平衡的、分布式的工作，而密集的硬件无法很好地自动执行。
